title: Minecraft Villager
blurb: Nasal, noncommittal and endlessly reusable. The villager's hmm is the noise of gaming's most economically ruthless NPC pretending to consider your offer. In game it accompanies a trade that is almost certainly terrible for you and excellent for a man in a brown robe. Online it has become shorthand for pure incomprehension: play it when instructions make no sense, when somebody proposes splitting the bill creatively, or as a reply to any question you would rather not answer directly. Remarkably expressive for one syllable from a character with no discernible neck.
origin: The villager trade grunt from Minecraft (Mojang).
